meta.title: StrategyByte Dental Care — Dhanmondi
meta.description: StrategyByte Dental Care, Dhanmondi. Talk to Nusrat in Bangla and book a visit.

hero.kicker: A Bangla voice agent for clinics in Bangladesh
hero.title: Patients book even when the front desk is busy
hero.sub: Nusrat answers in Bangla, then books, reschedules, or cancels. Staff see every call afterwards.
hero.body: For dental clinics and hospital front desks. She takes missed calls, after-hours questions, and the same enquiries all day. She does not give medical advice.

problem.title: Where the front desk drops calls

items.title: Missed calls
items.body: Busy hours mean a ringing phone and a patient who books somewhere else.

items.title: After hours
items.body: Friday and after 8pm, nobody is there to take a booking.

items.title: Paper booking
items.body: Names, numbers, and times live in a notebook.

items.title: Reception load
items.body: The same questions, all day: hours, address, fees, which doctor.

items.title: The same questions
items.body: Address, fees, which doctor — patients ask all day.

steps.title: The patient talks
steps.body: They turn the microphone on and say, in Bangla, why they want to come in.

steps.title: Nusrat confirms
steps.body: She checks open times and reads them back. The seat is kept only after they say yes.

steps.title: Staff see it in the portal
steps.body: The call, transcript, name, number, and seat stay in one place.

items.title: Bangla and code-switching
items.body: scaling, root canal, doctor — kept in English the way Dhaka says them.

items.title: Book, move, cancel
items.body: Look up by mobile number, then move or cancel the slot.

items.title: FAQ
items.body: Hours, directions, services, fees, preparation — only from the clinic record.

items.title: Human handover
items.body: A callback when she is unsure. Emergency signs go to hospital, then an urgent callback.

items.title: Your name and number
items.body: She repeats them so the seat is not written down wrong.

items.title: A reminder later
items.body: The booked seat stays at the clinic, so they can remind you before the day.

items.a: No. Nusrat books and reads clinic facts. She does not diagnose or name medicines.
No. Fridays and holidays are closed. Hours are 10:00–20:00.

items.q: Can the clinic see what I said?
items.a: Yes. After the call, your name, number, and seat are with the front desk.

items.q: How do I talk to her?
items.a: Press the button on this page, allow the microphone, and speak in Bangla.
